data.headline: GWW Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Pressures Persist Despite Solid Revenue Growth
data.summary: Maintenance and repair supplier W.W. Grainger (NYSE:GWW) reported Q2 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.6% year on year to $4.55 billion. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $17.85 billion at the midpoint came in 0.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $9.97 per share was 0.9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
